title: Dissolve Kernels and Modules Into Event-Sourced Artifacts
description:
Dissolve and unify every remaining imperative kernel/module into CQRS event-sourced artifacts with the full facet family (schema, snapshot, diff, mutations, inferences). No regular CRUD-based implementation may remain anywhere in the Rust artifact runtime. The artifact layer is already properly event-sourced at the top (ArtifactStore -> vcs -> spr -> backbone), but every computational kernel below it is imperative: the brep kernel (17,439 LOC across ~30 files) mutates topology arenas via register_solid/face/wire and &mut self Euler/boolean ops behind a host-owned BrepEngineHost; the 2d module runs a PARALLEL non-artifact store (DrawingStore/DrawingEngine over EngineCache) with set_fill/set_stroke setters; two distinct mesh implementations (framework mesh 2,545 LOC, 3d/mesh 2,769 LOC) expose set_vertex_position-style APIs; surface (paint/terrain/node-graph/tiled-map, 73 setters) and platform hold setter-based UI state; flow/vcs still uses banned CollectionMutation (40 hits); db LiveQuery hand-rolls self.snapshot = new_snapshot. Meanwhile 70 set-snapshot mutation dirs exist repo-wide (14 of 15 stdio semio subsets), which is CRUD wearing artifact clothing. Doctrine (policy-checkable): (a) authoritative state lives ONLY in ArtifactStore envelopes as snapshot fields; (b) every state change is a semantic mutation triad using SMO's closed APPROVED_VERBS, diff built from (payload, base), inverse from base; (c) all derived computation is an inference facet with DepHash dependency caching; (d) ephemeral working representations (halfedge adjacency, BVH, brep arenas, tessellation buffers) exist ONLY as locals inside a diff constructor or InferredField compute body, never as durable fields; (e) pure compute stays in engine crates consumed only from facet code, and standalone solver runs (e.g. WFC) get artifact shape with the problem spec as snapshot and the solution as an inference. Edit-vs-derivation rule: a gesture changing authoritative geometry (boolean, extrude, Euler op, fillet) is a group_id-batched mutation whose diff is computed by pure engine fns on an ephemeral rep; a view/query/measure (tessellation, normals, AABB, mass properties, validation, flattened scene) is an inference. Bulk/procedural generation goes through ArtifactStore::reset, never a mutation storm. Mechanism: new EngineRep

trait (ephemeral-representation contract) and DraftEngineSession in the os engine module; EngineCache narrowed to the wasm host boundary only; engine-crate extraction (brep/mesh/drawing) as pure fns over Arena::from_snapshot(base); BrepEngineHost and DrawingStore deleted; drawing value types relocated into the stdio drawing subset schema; flow CollectionMutation replaced by named triads; LiveQuery routed through InferredField. Executed by an Opus 5 coordinator dispatching Sonnet 5 executors (one file boundary each) and Haiku 4.5 read-only scouts for recon and adversarial re-verification, across waves: W0 recon+handshakes, W1 mechanism, W2 exemplars (platform, then a brep leaf with benchmark diff), W3a brep/mesh/2d fan-out in dependency-cluster lanes, W3b surface, W3c flow/db/infinite/renderer, W5 serializer, W6 policy ratchet at script.ts queue position 4, W7 adversarial verify + close. Coordinated by explicit handshake with three concurrent sessions (SEMANTIC-MUTATIONS-OVERHAUL, UNIFIED-COMPOSABLE-ARTIFACT-SYSTEM, ARTIFACTS-ONLY-PLUGIN-ARCHITECTURE) sharing this tree. Greenfield: no compatibility layers, no legacy, fixtures regenerated. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/dissolve-and-unify-all-splendid-fountain.md
